They knew it could be used for fraud, they provided it to accomplice who used it to obtain victim's personal data and then transferred 5.69 million yuan from victim's bank account. The prosecution says they are liable for fraud (诈骗罪) as they aided fraud. Also possibly "帮助信息网络犯罪活动罪" (aiding cyber crime) but the label list only includes certain charges: we have seen examples: 故意伤害, 放火, 盗窃, etc. Need to see which charge label matches this scenario. So "诈骗" is a generic charge.
